description: Create or delete nic tags on SmartOS systems.

parameters.name: etherstub
parameters.description: Specifies that the nic tag is attached to a created etherstub. Parameter etherstub is mutually exclusive with both mtu, and mac. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: When state=absent this switch uses the -f parameter and delete the nic tag regardless of existing VMs. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: mac
parameters.description: Specifies the mac address to attach the nic tag to when not creating an etherstub. Parameters mac and etherstub are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: mtu
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the mtu of the desired nic tag. Parameters mtu and etherstub are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete a SmartOS nic tag. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create 'storage0' on '00:1b:21:a3:f5:4d'
  community.general.nictagadm:
    name: storage0
    mac: 00:1b:21:a3:f5:4d
    mtu: 9000
    state: present

- name: Remove 'storage0' nic tag
  community.general.nictagadm:
    name: storage0
    state: absent

return_values.name: etherstub
return_values.description: Specifies if the nic tag was created and attached to an etherstub. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: force
return_values.description: Shows if -f was used during the deletion of a nic tag. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: mac
return_values.description: MAC Address that the nic tag was attached to. Returned: always Sample: "00:1b:21:a3:f5:4d"

return_values.name: mtu
return_values.description: Specifies which MTU size was passed during the nictagadm add command. mtu and etherstub are mutually exclusive. Returned: always Sample: 1500

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Nic tag name. Returned: always Sample: "storage0"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the target. Returned: always Sample: "present"
